text:
mira: heads up — multiple customers reporting p95/p99 jumps on chat generation since last midnight. p95 ~420ms (was ~120ms), p99 ~1.2s. Customer CS ticket D-4538 attached.
alex: which model/region? any common denom (gpu type, model size)?
mira: mostly gpt-medium variants on us-west-2; traces show more time in attention kernels. stack traces show `flash_attn` path slower.
ben: I see a large compile job landed around 2026-03-16 23:45 UTC that flipped `-DUSE_SDPA=1` and updated kernel selection heuristics.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-16T23:45:12Z completed by ci/pipeline #4821 — compileflags: `-O3 -march=native -DUSE_SDPA=1` — rollout to dedicated pools.
linda: customer onded says latency spike correlates to our deploy window.
sam: can we repro locally? any deterministic way to force the path? what workloads? long-seq chat + short chat both show impact but long sequences worse.
alex: repro quick: run perf harness with seq lens 2048/1024 and batch sizes 1/4. command:
```
./run_perf --model gpt-medium --seq 1024 --batch 1 --gpu a100 -r 500
```
ben: when I toggle the kernel selector back to prefer flashattn variant (old heuristic) latencies fall back to baseline.
mira: quick mitigation options? rollback compile flags? hotpatch binary rebuild? routing to smaller model variants?
ben: short-term: add routing rule to prefer model-variant `gpt-medium-v1.9` (pre-compileflag) for us-west-2 and dedicated pools. I've queued the route change: `routectl set-priority --region us-west-2 --model gpt-medium-v1.9 --priority 100`
alex: medium-term: rebuild binaries with `-DUSE_SDPA=0` and push a hotfix build to dedicated. that'll require a rolling deploy — estimate ~45m.
oncall: I can coordinate the rollout window. propose start in 15m, can do incremental to avoid capacity churn.
sam: logging action items — (1) apply routing rule (ben) (2) start hotfix rebuild w/ USE_SDPA=0 (alex) (3) monitor p95/p99 on canary (mira) (4) open rollback RFC for compileflag change (sam).
linda: notified affected customers, we'll update in 30m with mitigation plan.
mira: thanks all. for trace bucket: https://trace.redwood.internal/r/abc123 — shows kernel time breakdown (attention up from 30ms->260ms for p95).
ben: after applying route rule on a small shard, p95 dropped to ~130ms in that shard. will expand.
alex: build started (CI job #4890) and will push artifact to staging. logs:
```
[CI] building with flags: -O3 -march=native -DUSE_SDPA=0
[CI] artifact: runtime-binary-20260317-hotfix.tar.gz
```
mira: I'll keep CS updated. will post when p95 globally stabilizes. :thumbsup:
